manual_version: TU21 (final, 2025-04-08; Section 5 ARENA V4, Section 6 Game Details V13, Section 8 ROBOT Construction Rules V11)

auto_rp.description: All non-BYPASSED ROBOTS LEAVE and at least 1 CORAL scored in AUTO (Table 6-2)

coral_rp.description: At least the threshold number of CORAL scored on each of the 4 REEF levels (L1-L4); with the Coopertition Bonus, on each of at least 3 levels (Table 6-2; 7 per level at the FIRST Championship per Team Update 21)

barge_rp.description: At least the threshold number of BARGE points (PARK 2, shallow CAGE 6, deep CAGE 12) (Table 6-2; 16 at the FIRST Championship per Team Update 21)

coopertition_bonus.description: In Qualification MATCHES, at least 2 ALGAE scored in each ALLIANCE'S PROCESSOR: all teams earn 1 Coopertition Point (a ranking tiebreaker, not a ranking point) and the CORAL RP needs only 3 levels (section 6.5.3)

robot_constraints.note: Weight excludes BUMPERS, the battery, and event-provided location tags (R103); with BUMPERS 135 lbs (R408). Perimeter and height (3 ft 6 in) per R104.

analysis_hints.endgame_activity: Cage climbing (shallow or deep) typically occurs in the final 20 seconds.
analysis_hints.scoring_context: Coral is scored on the Reef at 4 levels (L1-L4). Higher levels score more points. Algae can go to the Processor (6 pts) or Net (4 pts).
analysis_hints.cycle_time: Coral cycle = intake from station -> score on Reef. Track time between successive Reef scores. Algae cycle is separate.
analysis_hints.auto_importance: Auto Coral scores are worth more than teleop. Leaving scores 3 pts. The AUTO RP needs every robot to leave and at least 1 Coral scored in auto.
analysis_hints.reef_context: CORAL RP needs at least 5 Coral on each of the 4 levels (7 at the FIRST Championship); with the Coopertition Bonus only 3 levels are needed. Coordinate with alliance partners for level coverage.
analysis_hints.barge_context: BARGE RP needs 14+ Barge points (16 at the FIRST Championship): deep cage (12) + park (2), or two shallow cages (6 + 6) + park (2).
